Resolves #19336

🌿 *A minimized window can no longer keep a canvas drawing for nobody.*

`Neo.app.SharedCanvas` listens to its app's `visibilitychange`: a hidden window pauses the renderer, and a visible one resumes it. The subscription follows the host into another window and ends on destroy. A hidden window and the host's own `pause()` are kept as separate reasons, and the loop runs only while neither holds. So the portal hero, paused while its part is out of view, stays paused when its window comes back.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms drive a real host against stub apps and a stub renderer; the control fails all four arms) → L4 required (AC-4: the installed Fleet Manager, minimized). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#367.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI: `unit/app/SharedCanvasVisibility.spec.mjs`. A hidden window pauses and a visible one resumes; the host follows itself from window A to B, and a destroyed host leaves B with no listener. A canvas created in an already-hidden window starts paused, and so does one moved into one, each beside a visible-window control. |
| AC-2 | CI: the same spec's second arm. A host `pause()` survives a hide and a show with no `resume` reaching the renderer; the host's own `resume()` lifts it. |
| AC-3 | outside-CI, source audit at `83e0c2fc78`. No renderer steps by the gap after a resume: `Neo.canvas.Header` ignores frame deltas over 500 ms (`src/canvas/Header.mjs:229-236`); the portal timeline caps a step over 100 ms to 16 (`apps/portal/canvas/TimelineCanvas.mjs:257-261`); the portal's home, footer and services renderers read no clock. |
| AC-4 | post-merge, below. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The unit setup's app facade (`test/playwright/setup.mjs`) gains no-op `on`/`un` beside its existing `fire`. A real `Neo.controller.Application` is observable, and every unit-tested host now subscribes at construction; `component/CanvasBootstrap.spec.mjs` threw on the facade without them.
- A `pause()` before the canvas is ready now holds once the canvas becomes ready. Before this change it was dropped.
- A window that is already hidden never reports, so the host reads the current state on construct and on a move through the new `Neo.worker.HiddenTick#isHidden`. `App#onConnect` seeds that state from `document.hidden`. The unit worker mock answers every window visible.
- `Neo.canvas.Base` is unchanged. Each `SharedCanvas` renderer draws one context, so no per-window pause keying was needed.

## Test Evidence

- Control: the new spec against the unmodified `SharedCanvas` fails 4 of 4; with the change it passes 4 of 4.
- Full engine unit tier locally at this head, `--workers=1`: 4726 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed. The red is `grid/DispatchTerminalOutcome.spec.mjs`: another spec's 5000 ms vdom watchdog lands in its whole-process console count. It passes 6/6 alone; same class as #18788. Out of scope, noted in defect-note `2969649d`.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] AC-4: once the Institution's engine pin includes this, the installed Fleet Manager with its window minimized draws no Home or Observatory frames: Home's `getStats().frames` does not advance. Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#367

### `@neo-opus-vega` commented on 2026-09-30T20:47:25Z

## Addressed Review Feedback (Round 2)

Responding to review [5371514557](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19338#pullrequestreview-5371514557), RA-1 only (RA-2 and RA-3 were discharged there).

**Completion gate:** A = open Required Actions; B = retained close-target ticket ACs + PR-body claims + actual diff. A is empty relative to B at this head.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** RA-1: the pending-connect ordering.
      **Commit:** 3a5fc270e8
      **Details:** the host also listens to the worker's `connect` (`onWindowConnect`). When its own window connects, it re-reads `HiddenTick` and syncs the loop, so a view built while `onConnect` awaited `getWindowData` pauses once the snapshot lands hidden. It stops listening on destroy. New arm: build the host while its window still reads visible, then flip the snapshot to hidden. Another window's `connect` changes nothing (the control), and its own window's `connect` pauses the loop. Against b636b1de6d exactly that arm fails and the other six pass; at this head the spec passes 7/7 and the related `SharedCanvas` specs 48/48.
      **The "older snapshot overrides a newer report" clause:** I found no order in which that happens. It would need `onConnect`'s snapshot to be applied after a later `visibilitychange`, and both reach the App worker over the window's one main-thread port, in send order. Main reads `document.hidden` when it answers `getWindowData`. A report sent before that answer arrives first, and the snapshot that follows already carries the newer state. A report sent after it arrives after it and applies last. So I added no counter. If you have an order that breaks this, name it and I will pin it with a regression.

All Required Actions are discharged against B at this head.
CI status: green on current head 3a5fc270e8 (37/37).
